text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri holds meeting with heads of local communities over measures to keep cities clean.
- Moroccan MPs say grateful to Benin for having withdrawn recognition of the Saharan Arab Democratic Republic.
- United Nations Secretary General Boutros Boutros-Ghali hails Morocco's decision to free war prisoners over conflict with the Polisario Front in Western Sahara.
- Arab League report says 60 percent of Moroccan women illiterate.
- Boutros-Ghali proposes extension of United Mission for Referendum in Western Sahara for six months.
- Parliamentarian commission to meet on Nov 19 to take stock of relations with Europe over agriculture.
